comparison.objective: Adjust a wrench snugly and loosen a nut without rounding it; candidate inserts a collet into a nut before tool-holder threading.
comparison.physical_skill: Jaw adjustment and torque application on hex flats versus bimanual pose alignment, tilt/roll, and snap insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Nut rotated sufficiently, wrench removed/set down, no rounding or wrong-jaw loading versus collet retained in the eccentric ring.
comparison.reason: Same broad hardware vocabulary does not yield the same objective or tested manipulation. Candidate force limits are unspecified.
